kind: Arknights: Endfield — Metal Scar Radio official albums (batch 2: Eve of Departure / Thunder's Legacy / At the Wake of Spring / Contingency Contract Re-Ignition / Homecoming / Dreamscape of Wind and Snow)
sourceNote: Track order, titles, and artist credits come from the official Spotify album pages (©/℗ 2026 GRYPHLINE, label Metal Scar Radio 鐵痕電臺) and were re-read on 2026-10-11 from the official Spotify album embed pages for all six albums, plus the official ffm.to smart link for Homecoming (Data Controller: Arknights: Endfield), whose Spotify destination is album 1OUsAGgNlKQWUWQ154UN2v. Individual song links are official Spotify track pages; album links are official Spotify album pages. No Chinese official titles were verified for this batch (planned next stage), so no match aliases are registered. Other stores do carry some of these albums (Apple Music, Amazon Music, TIDAL and Qobuz artist/album pages list them as of 2026-10-11), but their per-album and per-song URLs were not cross-checked, so every catalog link stays on the official Spotify pages. Checked 2026-10-11.

verification.albumTracklists: Ordered tracklists (title + artist + count) of all six albums read from https://open.spotify.com/embed/album/<albumId>; Homecoming also confirmed on the official ffm.to smart link above.
verification.notChecked: The remaining 75 per-track Spotify IDs were taken from the 2026-10-11 album-page fetch and were not opened one by one; region availability and login requirements were not tested in a real browser.
